note: BH-9177. 1: bin/test-impact-gate.sh passes --rerun-red to bin/suite-reuse.sh plan, so a suite with a fail row in the suite ledger at its own fingerprint runs again, as before C1. 0: that suite does not run; it is red from the ledger (`impact-gate: red from the suite ledger <suite> (run <id>)`), the verdict is FAILED and --failed names it. 1 by default because a fail row is sticky at its key for every PR that shares the fingerprint, and a fix round needs the suite's log.
